description: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of Different Categories,” visually represents the proportional breakdown of a dataset into seven distinct categories, with the largest segment being “Math” at 29.3% (410,756 entries), followed by “Coding” at 28.3% (339,907 entries), and “Information Seeking” at 22.2% (311,427 entries). The remaining categories, “Reasoning” (10.4%, 145,329), “Planning” (2.3%, 31,757), “Creative Writing” (2.2%, 30,144), and “Others (combined)” (9.3%, 130,671), are shown as smaller slices. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each category to its corresponding color and exact count, and percentage labels are also displayed directly on the chart for each slice, allowing for direct comparison of proportions. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with Math at the top-left and proceeding clockwise.
